title: Merge, prune and print counts
hints: `MergeCounts`: start from a copy of `a` so `a` itself is never written. `maps.Clone(nil)` returns `nil`, so build `out := make(map[string]int, len(a)+len(b))` and `maps.Copy(out, a)` instead. Then `for k, v := range b { out[k] += v }`.
`Prune`: `maps.DeleteFunc(m, func(k string, v int) bool { return v < minCount })`. A plain `for k, v := range m { if v < minCount { delete(m, k) } }` works too: deleting while ranging is safe.
`PrintCounts`: `if len(m) == 0 { fmt.Println("(none)"); return }`, then `for _, k := range slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(m)) { fmt.Printf("%s: %d\n", k, m[k]) }`.
